title: sourceAudit
responsibility: Verifies clean committed task source while allowing only bookkeeping changes to an unchanged declared loop contract.

inputs.name: sourceAudit.root
inputs.description: Project filesystem root used to read committed source, loop metadata or verification evidence.

inputs.name: sourceAudit.input
inputs.description: Declared task or observation metadata appropriate to the named operation.

outputs.name: sourceAudit
outputs.description: Current committed source ID after rejecting unrelated writes or changes to the committed task contract.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid or uncommitted task source, dirty unrelated files or a changed declared contract rejects.
